layer1.name: Simple Analytics
layer1.one_liner: Privacy-first website analytics with no cookies.
layer1.description: A minimal analytics script that collects no personal data, sold as a subscription. Started as a solo project directly against a free incumbent, in the same window as several similar competitors.
layer1.outcome_note: Bootstrapped from a few hundred dollars MRR in the first weeks to a reported $35k+ MRR with a two-person team, later above $50k MRR. Operates as an open startup, publishing its numbers.
